lifecycle.purge.reason: Background deletion after the cancellation deadline, not a user request (RT-6a reviewed, kept). The scheduled worker (T-128) authorizes each stage with its job's claim fence (one locked read per stage) and lists the subject's files once (one read), so a lost lease stops the purge before it writes. Largest run, one owned file: 8 transaction, 10 locked read, 7 read, 3 write.
